subject: math
verificationNotes: Hand-authored; numeric answers checked with sympy.
intro: A scatterplot shows paired data; a line (or curve) of best fit models the trend. The slope of a linear model is the predicted change in $y$ per unit increase in $x$, and the y-intercept is the predicted $y$ at $x=0$. Positive association rises to the right, negative falls. Use the model to predict (interpolate within the data) and interpret slope and intercept in context, avoiding extrapolation far outside the data.

items.prompt: A line of best fit $\hat{y}=3x+1$ relates hours ($x$) to pages ($y$). Interpret the slope.

steps: The slope is the change in $y$ per unit increase in $x$.
Here each additional hour predicts $3$ more pages.
So the slope means $3$ pages per hour.
The y-intercept is the predicted $y$ when $x=0$.

items.prompt: Association sign for a falling trend.
